title: Relax & Play -Ultimate Retreat- Pickleball & more!
description: Welcome to the Ultimate Scottsdale Pickleball Retreat. Meticulously designed for the discerning traveler. Prime Scottsdale location near Old Town, Scottsdale Quarter, Kierland. Ideal for epic getaways with a large groups celebrating birthdays, reunions & golf trips. Multiple suites, stylish bunk room. Activities include pickleball, basketball, pool, hot tub, corn hole, fire-pit. Backyard outshines resorts, offering adventure, luxury, ensuring legendary stays.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
